# MOBI compatibility corpus

The automated MOBI fixtures are generated by the tests in
`src/mobi.rs` and are covered by this repository's MIT license. They
exercise uncompressed and PalmDOC MOBI6/7/AZW, generated KF8/AZW3, cover/image
resources, UTF-8 metadata, `filepos` links, DRM markers, malformed
offsets, cancellation, and conversion limits without checking a
third-party ebook into the repository.

The converter was also manually validated on the Project Gutenberg
eBook #2130 public-domain downloads on 2026-07-30:

- `pg2130-images.mobi`
  (`e6b4f9364f5b4ff3335536ece37e552959007dd792c9a8edfd07f5ed1b32f181`)
- `pg2130-images-kf8.mobi`
  (`49b977d6203349dd59fa0fcdac33cd5c8aad688d329784bfbabd47dc0181c839`)

Source: <https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/2130/>
